summary: Written by the data agent at build time, pending a real judge. Players name artists and the game finds their tour: taylor swift is The Eras Tour, coldplay offers their two.
reasons: Casual run by artist found The Eras Tour, Music of the Spheres, After Hours til Dawn, Farewell Yellow Brick Road, 360, M72 and Love On Tour; Bruno Mars cost a life.
Each tour has its artist as an alias, shared across that artist's tours (the Rolling Stones and U2 offer their four biggest).
Small pool (67 tours, 51 with a gross), so a thin Blitz: famous artists without a listed tour score nothing.
